Package com.salesforce.multicloudj.pubsub.ali

Class SmqCredentialsProvider

java.lang.Object
com.salesforce.multicloudj.pubsub.ali.SmqCredentialsProvider
public final class SmqCredentialsProvider extends Object
Maps a multicloudj CredentialsOverrider to an Alibaba credentials provider for the SMQ (MNS) CloudAccount.

Only an absent override falls back to ambient credentials: this returns null for a null overrider or null type, and the caller then resolves the Alibaba default credential chain. Any explicit override that cannot be honored fails fast rather than silently using ambient credentials:

  • SESSION with session credentials → a static session-credentials provider (the credential values are passed to the SDK, which evaluates them);
  • SESSION without session credentials → InvalidArgumentException;
  • ASSUME_ROLE / ASSUME_ROLE_WEB_IDENTITY → UnSupportedOperationException (TODO: not yet implemented for SMQ).

    • getCredentialsProvider

      public static com.aliyuncs.auth.AlibabaCloudCredentialsProvider getCredentialsProvider(CredentialsOverrider overrider)
      Returns an Alibaba credentials provider for the given overrider, or null only when the override is absent (the caller then resolves the default credential chain).
      Parameters:
      overrider - the credentials override
      Returns:
      a static session provider for a SESSION override with session credentials, or null when the override is absent
      Throws:
      InvalidArgumentException - if a SESSION override carries no session credentials
      UnSupportedOperationException - if the override type is not yet supported for SMQ
